entry.name: tosymbol
entry.digest: Convert messages, numbers, or lists to a single symbol
entry.description: tosymbol accepts any message, number, or list, and converts it into a single symbol. The symbol has a maximum length of 2048 characters.

attributes.digest: Specifies the separator character or symbol to be used when concatenating.
attributes.description: Specifies the separator character or symbol to be used when concatenating. The messagewith no arguments removes all spaces when creating a symbol (e.g.,becomes). When used with slash or colon separators, theattribute can be used to construct pathnames (e.g.,becomes). The default separator is a space.
